answer: Assign each answer's grading panel by sortition seeded from an unpredictable randomness beacon, not by the claimant's choice. An attacker cannot forge the draw in advance, so they cannot stack a jury of their own sockpuppets; the selection arrives like a violet flash they never saw coming. At the zenith of an attack, when the swarm is largest, the odds of controlling a randomly drawn quorum still forge toward zero.
